annotations.text:
A — Unified footer (recommended)
The waitlist band and footer become one dark section: CTA on top, sitemap below a hairline. Kills the ~600px double-band, gives the email controls a clear home in the reading path.
Tradeoff: still a wide banner — the form shares the top row with the headline.

B — Centered CTA
Everything centered; the email field sits dead-center as the one focal control, then a single thin footer strip. Shortest and most editorial.
Tradeoff: less room for the sitemap — links compress to two inline runs.

C — Split sign-off
Classic SaaS footer: a dedicated signup panel on the left, full sitemap on the right, one sign-off row beneath. Best if the link list needs to stay prominent.
Tradeoff: tallest of the three; the stacked form is less punchy than an inline one.
